info.title: Metricool API
info.description:
Metricool API

The base URL for all endpoints is: https://app.metricool.com/api

All endpoints require authentication. To identify yourself properly, you must include 3 parameters in all calls

You can add the parameters directly in the request (the only parameter that can be implemented in the header with name X-Mc-Auth is the userToken)

  • userToken: It is a unique authorization code for each user and can be found in the account settings.
  • userId: the user identifier of your Metricool account.
  • blogId: It is the identification number of the brand, this number can be easily found from the browser url

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description:
metric Supported values: Metrics are case insensitive
  • For TikTokAds: impressions, cost, clicks, conversions, cpm, cpc, ctr
  • For TikTok Videos: videos, views, comments, shares, interactions, likes, reach, engagement, impressionSources, averageVideoViews
  • For TikTok Account: video_views, profile_views, followers_count, followers_delta_count, likes, comments, shares
  • For Pinterest: impression save pin_click outbound_click video_mrc_view video_avg_watch_time video_v50_watch_time quartile_95_percent_view pins
  • For Pinterest (accounts): followers, following, delta followers
  • For Youtube: views, interactions, likes, dislikes, comments, shares
  • For Facebook (metrics for stories): storiesCount
  • For Facebook (metrics for posts): count, interactions, engagement, impressionsunique, impressions, clicks, comments, shares, reactions
  • For Facebook (metrics for reels): blue_reels_play_count, post_impressions_unique, post_video_likes_by_reaction_type, post_video_social_actions, engagement, count
  • For Facebook (account metrics): page_posts_impressions, page_actions_post_reactions_total, postsCount, postsInteractions, likes, pageFollows, pageImpressions, pageImpressions.M, pageImpressions.F, pageImpressions.U, pageImpressions.13-17, pageImpressions.18-24, pageImpressions.25-34, pageImpressions.35-44, pageImpressions.45-54, pageImpressions.55-64, pageImpressions.65+, pageViews, page_daily_follows_unique, page_daily_unfollows_unique
  • For GMB: business_impressions_maps, business_impressions_search, business_impressions_total, business_direction_requests, call_clicks, website_clicks, clicks_total, business_conversations, business_bookings, business_food_orders, business_actions_total
  • For Instagram (account metrics): email_contacts, get_directions_clicks, phone_call_clicks, text_message_clicks, clicks_total, postsCount, postsInteractions, delta_followers, followers_gained, followers_lost
  • For Instagram (posts metrics): count, interactions, engagement, reach, impressions, likes, comments, saves, shares
  • For Instagram (reels metrics): count, comments, likes, saved, shares, engagement, impressions, reach, interactions, videoviews
  • For Instagram (breakdown metrics, correct subject and scope are needed): comments, likes, profile_links_taps, reach, saved, saves, shares, total_interactions, views
  • For Linkedin (account metrics [company]): followers, paidFollowers, companyImpressions, deltaFollowers, impressionCount, shareCount, clickCount, likeCount, commentCount, postsCount

Get the users that can be mentioned in the notes of the brand's Inbox conversations.
get.description:
Whoever can read those notes, so a mention never names somebody the note will not reach. On a brand of an agency white-label that also covers the agency team members and the agency end clients. Deleted accounts are excluded. Rejected for sessions that cannot mention (integrator and white-label end clients, Vendasta, anonymous). Requires `fullAccessInbox`, the same permission writing a note needs: a read-only Inbox session can never mention anybody. The whole list is returned: filtering by the typed text is done by the frontend over the loaded list.

To write a mention into the note content, interpolate the entry's `mentionId` and its `name` as `@[<mentionId>|<name>]`.

Use `mentionId` verbatim and never build it from `userId` or `agencyId`/`agencyUserId`: an agency end client has no `userId`, so composing the marker from it produces a marker the server cannot resolve and the mention is silently lost — the note saves, with no error, mentioning nobody.

Use `name` for the label. What is stored is taken from the mentioned account rather than from the request, because the label lives inside the note content and the content is served verbatim to every reader, including sessions that must not see email addresses. A label written beside an id this API cannot resolve is kept as sent, except for an email address, which is reduced to its local part.

Calendar and library: whoever can see the brand's posts. On a brand of an agency white-label that also covers the agency team members and the agency end clients. Deleted accounts are excluded. Rejected for sessions that cannot mention (integrator and white-label end clients, Vendasta and the anonymous reviewer). The whole list is returned: filtering by the typed text is done by the frontend over the loaded list.

To write a mention into the note content, interpolate the entry's `mentionId` and its `name` as `@[<mentionId>|<name>]`.

Use `mentionId` verbatim and never build it from `userId` or `agencyId`/`agencyUserId`: an agency end client has no `userId`, so composing the marker from it produces a marker the server cannot resolve and the mention is silently lost — the note saves, with no error, mentioning nobody.

Use `name` for the label. What is stored is taken from the mentioned account rather than from the request, because the label lives inside the note content and the content is served verbatim to every reader, including sessions that must not see email addresses. A label written beside an id this API cannot resolve is kept as sent, except for an email address, which is reduced to its local part.

put.summary: Approve or reject the reviewer's posts
put.description: Authenticated (brand reviewer session only). Records this reviewer's approve/reject decision on one or more posts in their pending set — one id or many, same contract — and returns a per-post result. An unknown {publicId}, or one that belongs to another reviewer, returns 404 (the two are indistinguishable, on purpose, so the status can't be used to probe which portals exist); an internal Metricool user session is rejected with 403. Applied best-effort: a post that is not in the reviewer's set or is no longer actionable is reported as a failed result, not a 4xx. At most 100 posts are acted on per call; extra ids (after de-duplication) are ignored.

get.summary: List the note thread of a post in the review portal
get.description: Authenticated. Accepts the brand reviewer session, or a Metricool user allowed to approve posts on the brand (the brand owner, or a collaborator with the approve-posts permission) — the internal preview is read-only (adding notes stays reviewer-only). Returns the full note thread for a post in the portal reviewer's pending set, oldest first, including the agency's notes; the 'mine' flag is computed against the portal reviewer (not the caller), so the preview mirrors the reviewer's view. An unknown {publicId}, a portal of another reviewer, or a post outside the reviewer's pending set returns 404; a Metricool user without permission gets 403.

post.summary: Add a note to a post in the review portal
post.description: Authenticated (brand reviewer session only). Records a free-text note on a post assigned to this reviewer, independent of any approve/reject decision. The note is visible to the agency. An unknown {publicId}, one that belongs to another reviewer, or a post not assigned to this reviewer returns 404; an internal Metricool user session is rejected with 403; blank content or content over 3000 characters returns 400.

put.summary: Approve or reject the posts on a reviewer's task list
put.description: Authenticated. Records this reviewer's approve/reject decision on one or more of the posts waiting for them — one target or many, same contract — and returns a per-post result. The targets may span several brands: each brand is authorized on its own, and the caller must be allowed to approve posts (or hold full planner access) on it. Applied best-effort: a post that is not in the reviewer's set, is no longer actionable, or sits in a brand the caller may no longer approve on is reported as a failed result, not a 4xx. NOT_FOUND, NOT_ACTIONABLE and FORBIDDEN are terminal; ERROR is transient and retryable. An empty post list, more than 100 posts, a target missing its brand or post id, or a status other than 'approved' or 'rejected', is a 400 naming the offending field: a malformed list is rejected rather than partly acted on, so a decision is never applied to only part of what was sent. Repeated posts count once. The note is used only when rejecting.

LibraryPostAssignableUserDto.description: A user that can be assigned to library posts of a brand.

failures.description: Ids that could not be moved, each with its reason. Empty when everything moved.

postId.description: The id as it was submitted.

reason.description: Why a post listed in a bulk workflow state change could not be moved.

audioId.description: Unique identifier of the audio asset from the Instagram Audio API.

igUsername.description: Instagram username of the creator (populated for 'original_sound' type).

coverArtworkUrl.description: URL of the cover artwork thumbnail.

durationMs.description: Duration of the audio in milliseconds.

audioVolume.description: Volume level for the audio asset, from 0 (muted) to 100 (full volume). Defaults to 100.

videoVolume.description: Volume level for the video's original audio, from 0 (muted) to 100 (full volume). Defaults to 100.

isAiGenerated.description: Whether the Instagram post is flagged as AI-generated content (sent as is_ai_generated on publish).

profilePicture.description: Public URL of the author's 400x400 profile picture. Absent when they have none, in which case the frontend renders its initials fallback. Filled for agency-authored notes too.

mentions.description: Users mentioned in the content of the note, resolved when the note is read. Empty when the note mentions nobody.

mentionId.description: Identity of the note author, and the field to compare against your own to tell whether a note is yours. `12345` for a regular user, `a:<agencyId>:<agencyUserId>` for an agency end client. Prefer it over the raw id fields: an agency author's `userId` is not a regular-user id — it holds their id inside the agency, which is a different id space and can be the same number as an unrelated regular user, so comparing that one can answer "mine" on somebody else's note. Same shape as the `mentionId` of the mention picker, so the author of a note and the entry that mentions them carry the same string. Absent only for a note whose author could not be resolved.

allowedCountryCodes.description: A string list of valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that represents the countries where this media should be shown.

items.description: A string list of valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes that represents the countries where this media should be shown.

isSpoiler.description: A boolean that represents if isSpoiler is activated or not

replyControl.description: A string that represents who can reply to a Threads post, been EVERYONE by default. (EVERYONE, ACCOUNTS_YOU_FOLLOW,MENTIONED_ONLY,PARENT_POST_AUTHOR_ONLY,FOLLOWERS_ONLY)

shareAsInstagramStory.description: A boolean that represents if the Threads post must be cross-shared as an Instagram Story. The Story is published on the Instagram account linked to the Threads account, which may not match the Instagram account connected to this brand.

instagramStoryTheme.description: Theme used when the Threads post is cross-shared as an Instagram Story (LIGHT or DARK). Only allowed when shareAsInstagramStory is enabled; must be absent otherwise.

ScheduledPostThreadsData.description: Data needed for schedule a Threads post

title.description: Optional link title shown over the article link sticker.

ScheduledPostTikTokArticleLink.description: TikTok Article Link attached to a post: an external URL shown as a link sticker on the video.

Public URL of the author's 400x400 profile picture. Absent when they have none, in which case the frontend renders its initials fallback. Filled for agency-authored events too.

logoUrl.description: Header logo URL for the portal. Resolves the brand's owner (or their agency, if any); always populated — falls back to the app's own default logo when neither has one configured.

result.description: Outcome of the access request. LINK_SENT: a fresh link was just emailed. RECENT_LINK_STILL_VALID: a link was sent recently and is still in the inbox; none re-sent. NO_PENDING_REVIEW: nothing pending to review, no email sent.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds the reviewer must wait before another resend will actually send. Present for LINK_SENT (full cooldown) and RECENT_LINK_STILL_VALID (remaining); omitted otherwise.

result.description: Outcome. SENT: a fresh link was emailed to the reviewer now. NO_PENDING_REVIEW: nothing pending, no email sent. COOLDOWN_ACTIVE: blocked by the 1-minute resend cooldown, retry after secondsUntilNextResend.

secondsUntilNextResend.description: Seconds until a resend is allowed again. Present only when result=COOLDOWN_ACTIVE.

UpdateReviewerPortalLanguageRequest.description: New portal language for the authenticated reviewer's (reviewer, brand) link.

status.description: On a reviewer task, the reader's own answer. On an editor task, the state of the post they sent: pending while no answer settles it, whichever approval flavour it stores.

blogImage.description: Public URL of the brand's image: its own picture, or the one stored from its connected networks when it has none of its own. Both are stored values — a brand with neither gets no picture resolved from its live connections here, and the field is absent.

profilePicture.description: Public URL of the user's 400x400 profile picture. Absent when they have none, in which case the frontend renders its initials fallback.

postIds.description: Ids of the posts to decide on. One id for a single action, several for bulk. At most 100 distinct ids are processed per call; any beyond the first 100 are ignored.

items.description: Ids of the posts to decide on. One id for a single action, several for bulk. At most 100 distinct ids are processed per call; any beyond the first 100 are ignored.

status.description: The decision, applied to every listed post.

note.description: Optional note; used only when rejecting. Attached as a post note and included in the rejection email to each post's creator.

postId.description: The post this result refers to.

reviewerStatus.description: This reviewer's new decision on the post.

postApprovalStatus.description: Recomputed post-level approval status after this decision. Informational; normally present on success, absent only if the post was removed or the re-read failed.

error.description: Failure reason when the decision was not applied to a post. NOT_FOUND, NOT_ACTIONABLE and FORBIDDEN are terminal; ERROR is transient and retryable.

ReviewerPostDecisionResult.description: Outcome of the reviewer's decision for a single post.

results.description: One result per requested post, in request order.

ReviewerPostsDecisionResponse.description: Per-post outcomes of a reviewer's approve/reject action, one entry per requested post.

ReviewerNoteRequest.description: A brand reviewer's note on a post, independent of approve/reject.

author.description: Author display name (the reviewer's email for reviewer notes).

updated.description: True when the note has been edited since it was created.

mine.description: True when this note was authored by the portal reviewer.
